{"post": {"operationId": "startConformanceRun", "tags": ["Conformance runs"], "summary": "Start a persisted conformance run", "des
cription": "Grades the saved server against the protocol, apps, and tasks suites and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes
from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL. OAuth is not startable here. Poll the run detail for the verdic
t. Status, outcome, and score are three different answers.\n\nBy default the run uses the server's saved conformance settings: the
checks they select, their tool inputs and their run time budget. The receipt's `settingsSource` says what applied: `saved`, or `d
efaults` when the server has nothing saved. `settings: \"none\"` runs every check with no tool inputs. With saved settings, the st
art first checks which MCP protocol version the server speaks and leaves out any suite with no saved checks for that version, as t
he app does. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the run that key started, with its original suites and settings. A run
still going at its budget ends with its unfinished suites incomplete.\n\nOn hosted MCPJam, a user's starts past 30 in 10 minutes c
an be refused with `429` and `Retry-After`. A server that is restarting also answers `429` with `Retry-After`, with `details.reaso
n` `SERVER_DRAINING`.", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/components/parameters/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/serverId"}
, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/launcherHeader"}, {"name": "Idempotency-Key", "in": "header", "required": false, "description"
: "The body's `idempotencyKey` sent as a header. It wins over the body field.", "schema": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 256}}],
"requestBody": {"required": false, "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "p
roperties": {"suites": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "string", "enum": ["protocol", "apps", "tasks"]}, "descr
iption": "Suites to run. Defaults to protocol, apps, and tasks. OAuth is not available on this surface."}, "idempotencyKey": {"typ
e": "string", "maxLength": 200, "description": "Deduplicates a retried POST for the same saved server. Mapped to a namespaced exte
rnalRunId (`api:<projectId>:<serverId>:<key>`); a keyless start always inserts and spends quota."}, "protocolVersion": {"type": "s
tring", "enum": ["2025-03-26", "2025-06-18", "2025-11-25", "2026-07-28"], "description": "Pin one MCP protocol version. Without it
the run uses the version the server negotiates."}, "engineVersion": {"type": "string"}, "settings": {"type": "string", "enum": ["
saved", "none"], "description": "`saved` (the default) runs the server's saved conformance settings. `none` runs every check with
no tool inputs."}}}}}}, "responses": {"202": {"description": "The run was accepted and is executing.", "content": {"application/js
on": {"schema": {"type": "object", "required": ["runId", "projectId", "serverId", "status", "deduped", "requestedSuites"], "proper
ties": {"runId": {"type": "string"}, "projectId": {"type": "string"}, "serverId": {"type": "string"}, "status": {"type": "string"}
, "deduped": {"type": "boolean"}, "requestedSuites": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "settingsSource": {"type": "s
tring", "enum": ["saved", "defaults", "none"], "description": "The settings the run used. `defaults` means the server has no saved
settings, so every check runs."}}}}}}, "400": {"description": "The body carried an unknown key or an unknown `protocolVersion`, n
amed OAuth, asked only for suites the saved settings leave out, or the server uses a transport conformance cannot grade."}, "401":
{"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/componen
ts/responses/NotFound"}, "409": {"description": "The server's saved tool inputs could not be read. Save them again on the Conforma
nce page, or start with `settings: \"none\"`."}, "429": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/compone
nts/responses/InternalError"}, "502": {"description": "The saved server's address could not be resolved."}}}}
/projects/{projectId}/eval-runs {"post": {"operationId": "createEvalRun", "tags": ["Eval runs"], "summary": "Create an eval run (a
sync)", "description": "Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution an
d responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}
` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab, tagged `source: \"api\"`.\n\nA bare `suiteId` with no inline tests
reruns the suite as configured. Per-organization concurrency is capped (default 2 concurrent runs); exceeding it returns `429` wi
th `details.reason: \"CONCURRENT_RUN_LIMIT\"`.\n\nFor a suite with attached project environments, pass `environmentId` to choose w
hich one the run uses; the `202` echoes the resolved `environment` triple, and `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` reports the same triple fo
r the life of the run.\n\nTo make the run readable as something more specific than `API` in the Runs table, send `x-mcpjam-launche
r` (and `x-mcpjam-ci` from a CI job). Both are labels: `source` is stamped `api` either way.", "parameters": [{"$ref": "#/componen
ts/parameters/evalVocabularyHeader"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/projectId"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/launcherHea
der"}, {"$ref": "#/components/parameters/ciHeader"}], "requestBody": {"required": true, "content": {"application/json": {"schema":
{"$ref": "#/components/schemas/EvalRunCreateRequest"}, "example": {"suiteName": "smoke", "serverIds": ["srv_abc123"], "tests": [{
"title": "echo works", "runs": 1, "model": "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5", "provider": "anthropic", "steps": [{"id": "s1", "kind": "
prompt", "prompt": "Use the echo tool to say hi"}, {"id": "s2", "kind": "assert", "assertion": {"type": "toolCalledWith", "toolNam
e": "echo", "args": {"args": {"text": "hi"}}}}]}]}}}}, "responses": {"202": {"description": "Run created; execution continues in t
he background.", "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/EvalRunCreated"}, "example": {"runId":
"run_abc123", "suiteId": "suite_def456", "status": "running", "caseUpsert": {"committed": [{"name": "echo works"}], "failed": []},
"environment": null}}}}, "400": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/ValidationError"}, "401": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Unaut
horized"}, "403": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Forbidden"}, "404": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/NotFound"}, "429": {"$ref"
: "#/components/responses/RateLimited"}, "500": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/InternalError"}, "502": {"$ref": "#/components/re
sponses/ServerUnreachable"}, "504": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Timeout"}}}}
